title: Collapsible bar
description: A bordered bar with an icon, a title, a short hint and a round chevron button. Pressing it slides the content open and closed over about a quarter of a second, and the chevron turns upside down. Use it for help that people want sometimes (guides) so it does not take page space. Content goes inside it; the note shows as a grey strip at the bottom.
